note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 9568 Section 7.1 says "It MUST verify the VRRP checksum." TestDecodeVerifiesChecksumBothFamilies lost only the assertion on the removed MsgOnlyChecksum flag; it still accepts the message-only IPv4 golden and the IPv6 golden under the default mode and refuses a flipped checksum bit in each family with ErrChecksum. An overlay mutant that made the default mode sum the IPv4 pseudo-header reddened it. Verdict unchanged.
